evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository and sets local user.name/user.email, but never disables signing before the first commit. Git inherits global commit.gpgSign, so a developer or CI environment with commit.gpgSign=true will attempt to sign the baseline commit as fixture@example.invalid and fail when no matching key exists, erroring DeployFixture.setUp(). Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is the smallest hermetic fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
